sites.basis: Level only the small exhibit pad identified in the drone footage and overhead view. Tie to the standard terrain within a 4.8 m shoulder so the deck is continuous with the adjoining park ground.

sites.name: Mini Israel Teddy Stadium exhibit pad
sites.basis: Level the small stadium plinth and blend the edges into the standard terrain inside the park.

sites.name: Mini Israel Yad Eliyahu Arena exhibit in November 2011
sites.basis: Fit the level platform visible in the four dated panoramas to the retained coarse terrain. The grade tapers beyond the plinth and the visitor path continues across the blended surface.

sites.name: Mini Israel track and field exhibit in the 2012 photograph
sites.basis: A shallow grade supports the reconstructed display plinth during the 2012 visitor-photo view. The original terrain returns before the mapped path and the grade is inactive outside that date.

sites.name: Búsanyìn Shrine historical pad
sites.basis: Date-limited fit of the 2015 floor and landing within the mapped study area. Elevation follows the World Explorer Terrarium samples. The survey elevations were not transferred to the viewer terrain.

sites.name: Arugbá Gate forecourt path
sites.basis: Keep the continuous photographed path below the modeled paving after the renderer adds its landcover offset. The grade stays inside the grove and away from the mapped road.

sites.name: Arugbá Gate paved verge
sites.basis: The tour shows a continuous paved apron at the two iron leaves and a shallow approach to the pedestrian threshold. The illustrated grade follows the frontage and tapers into the retained terrain before the mapped carriageway.

sites.name: Mini Israel King David Hotel exhibit in the 2012 photograph
sites.basis: Expose the lower garden terrace in the dated model view. The local grade supports the photographed descent to the pool and tennis court. Elevation is reconstructed from the retained terrain rather than a surveyed miniature platform.

sites.name: Mini Israel airport exhibit in the 2012 photograph
sites.basis: The compact dated apron grade provides ground contact below the platform and blends toward the undisturbed visitor paths. The geometry and grading fit the archive photograph approximately.

sites.name: Ọṣun–Òṣogbo First Palace forecourt and foundations
sites.basis: The geotagged front photograph and courtyard footage show steps from a continuous approach into a nearly level court. The local grade exposes those treads and supports the modeled foundations over coarse Terrarium terrain. The original grade is approximate.

sites.name: Pontcysyllte Aqueduct and Dee crossing
sites.basis: Four-metre resampling of the Welsh Government 1 m LiDAR DTM. Restores the mapped embankment and narrow valley around the crossing. Height samples in metres, row-major in the rotated site frame.
